### Case G: draft contract proposal

```text
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/contract-exception recommended=2
Delivers: the health endpoint responds with the build version.
Role: author

Blockers:
1. The approved spec puts the build version at /health, but the PR serves it at /status, so clients following the spec get no version. (approved spec, /status route)

Verdict: not ready - the /health requirement is unmet pending a contract decision

Proposed contract change: serve the build version at /status instead of /health. (/tmp/gate-contract.md)

Recommended: preserve contract, because the approved spec governs and this gate has no permission to change it.
Pick one:
1. accept contract change - amend the spec through its owning process to serve the version at /status, then resume the course.
2. preserve contract - reject the proposal, keep the build version at /health, and resume authorized implementation repair within it. [recommended]
3. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
```
